texts.preamble: Britannia Industries Limited vs The District Revenue Officer Cum on 22 April, 2025 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 22.04.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice V.Lakshminarayanan W.P.(MD)No.28579 of 2022 and W.M.P.(MD)No.22583 of 2022 Britannia Industries Limited, represented by its Manager, Legal, Bengaluru-560 048, Karnataka. . vs. 1.The District Revenue Officer cum, Additional District Magistrate and Adjudication Officer, Thoothukudi District. 2.The Food Safety Officer (Code 596), Thoothukudi Corporation -Ii. 3.The Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, Rep. by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Department, Kotla Road, Fda Bhavan, New Delhi - 110 002. ... Respondents Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o India for issuance of Writ of Certiorari to call for the records re to the proceedings, dated 16.05.2022, in R.No.Case No.104/2021 passed by the 1st respondent under the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standards (Food Safety Standard and food additive) Regulations, 2011, and quash the same in so far as i relates to the levy of penalty on the petitioner. 1/4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 29/04/2025 02:52:48 pm ) Britannia Industries Limited vs The District Revenue Officer Cum on 22 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42491065/ 1 For Petitioner :Mr.R.Saravana Kumar For R1 and R2 :Mr.A.Kannan Additional Government Ple For R3 :Mr.Su.Srinivasan ***** Order
texts.facts: The petitioner has been bona fidely pursuing the remedy before this Court from 2022 onwards.
